ask: Retrieve the full text or detailed abstract of O'Neil, O'Neil, Weikum 1993 'The LRU-K Page Replacement Algorithm for Database Disk Buffering' (SIGMOD pp. 297-306, cited as [OOW] in O'Neil et al. 1993 SIGMOD paper): does [OOW] give a closed-form correction formula converting Mattson's stack-distance distribution n(Δ) into the LRU-K hit rate for K>1? Specifically search for: (1) the bt(p,K) backward K-distance definition and its relationship to n(Δ), (2) any equation expressing LRU-K(C) hit rate as a function of the stack-distance CDF, (3) whether LRU-K's miss ratio curve is bounded above by Mattson's CDF F(C) and below by some K-dependent correction term. Use Google Scholar, DBLP, Semantic Scholar, and the ACM DL (doi.org/10.1145/170035.170041). Return: the exact formula if it exists, or state explicitly whether the correction is derived numerically from bt(p,K) traces rather than closed-form from n(Δ).
